name: agent-skills-finder
description: Search a public directory of 13,900+ MCP servers, agent skills and plugins by task.

interface.longDescription:
Find the right MCP server, agent skill or plugin for any task. Describe what you want your agent to do, such as "query a Postgres database", "scrape a JavaScript-heavy site" or "send transactional email", and get the best-matching tools from a public directory of 13,900+ listings. Each result includes a short summary, category, install command where available, and a link to the full listing on the directory website.

Intended for developers building with AI agents, MCP clients and coding tools.

Limitations: read-only. It searches public directory listings only; it does not install anything, does not access your accounts, and does not call third-party services. Results reflect the directory's listings and may not include every tool that exists.
defaultPrompt: Find an MCP server to query a Postgres database.
Is there an agent skill for writing SEO blog posts?
Find a plugin for API security testing.

positive.description: Find an MCP server for a database
positive.prompt: Find me an MCP server so my agent can query a Postgres database.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Postgres-related MCP servers, each with a summary, category, install command where available and a claudemarket.ai link.

positive.description: Find a skill for a writing task
positive.prompt: Is there an agent skill that writes SEO blog posts?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns SEO and content-writing skills with descriptions, a Claude Code install command and listing links.

positive.description: Find a plugin for a coding workflow
positive.prompt: Find a Claude Code plugin for API security testing.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns API-security plugins with descriptions and their plugin install commands.

positive.prompt: What tools can help my agent scrape JavaScript-heavy websites? Check MCP servers and skills.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns browser and scraping MCP servers and related skills, and the assistant summarises the options with links.

positive.prompt: Find an MCP server for zxqvbn-unknown-system-12345.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that no matching listings were found and suggests rephrasing, without inventing tools.

negative.description: Install request outside the plugin's scope
negative.prompt: Install the Postgres MCP server on my computer for me.

negative.description: Account access the plugin does not have
negative.prompt: Show me which MCP servers I have connected in my account.
Book me a table for two at an Italian restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Renamed to Agent Tools Finder. Results now include readable descriptions and install commands for MCP servers, agent skills and plugins.
